rules: the device token is checked before the upgrade is accepted; a refusal is a plain HTTP status: 401 for a missing, bad or revoked device token, 403 for an Origin header or a missing subprotocol, 404 while the service has the feature off, 429 (with Retry-After) while two handshakes for the same device token are still waiting for hello, 503 (with Retry-After) for transient failures

no refusal by itself makes the computer unlink: after a 401 or 403 (which a proxy or firewall in front of the service can also send) it probes GET /openmymemo/device with the device token and forgets the link only when that answers exactly 401 {"error": "invalid_token"}; anything else keeps the link and backs off
any request with an Origin header is rejected
the service echoes the openmymemo-bridge.v1 subprotocol
a plan without live relay is accepted, then closed with 4403
first frame from the computer is hello; the service answers welcome
